text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oguri! O-gu-ri! C'mon, wake up already!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Don't ya "What is it?" me! You're the
one who
begged me to bring ya to the
cafeteria for lunch!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I was up all night trying to figure
something out...
Before I knew it, the sun
was up.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
And to make matters worse, I couldn't
solve my
problem... Can either of you
help me?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like ya were really racking your
brains last
night. Go on then, hit us with
it!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, I ate a rice ball while I was
running on
the track...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I thought that if I ate while training, it
would
make me stronger.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But it didn't make much of a difference.
Should I
be eating more? Or do I need
to swap out the rice
ball for some
bread?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Pretty sure that's not the issue here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Soon after, a half-asleep Oguri Cap
devours
lunch beside an astonished
Tamamo Cross.
